messages:
jia: Kicking off transit peering + egress NAT bring-up for eu-west-4 (new G4 cluster). I'll run routing + DNS smoke tests and post results. tagging @marta @sam for validation.

marta: Thanks — can you include a quick cost reminder for NAT gateways vs shared egress? want to flag to finance if this spikes.

sam: I left the terraform PR comment about the route table associations. Make sure the IGW/NAT attachment order matches the plan — last time we had asymmetric routes.

jia: noted. running initial checks now. 1) BGP session to transit-gw (tgw-02-euw4) 2) route table propagation 3) nat gateway assignment 4) private zone delegation to rwd-svc DNS.

net-bot: Deploy job #3821 started: tgws/peerings/apply (user=jia)

ryan: Quick pointer — for egress-cost, prefer single NAT per AZ with SNAT port exhaustion monitoring. If traffic is high, enable elastic IP pooling to avoid many EIPs.

jia: BGP status: session UP from eu-west-4 -> transit-gw, remote ASN 64512.

-- command output --
BGP state: Established
Prefix count received: 42
-- end --

elena: Can you confirm route table entries for the GPU node subnets? need to ensure /32 host routes for floating ips are present.

jia: Route tables: rtb-igw-001 (public) has 0.0.0.0/0 -> IGW, rtb-private-eu4 has 0.0.0.0/0 -> nat-01-eu4. Added explicit routes: 10.24.5.0/24 -> ENI of peering appliance, 10.24.5.99/32 -> floating.

sam: Paste the `aws ec2 describe-route-tables` snippet if you can. also confirm route propagation flags for TGW attachments.

jia: snippet:
```
{"RouteTables":[{"RouteTableId":"rtb-private-eu4","Routes":[{"DestinationCidrBlock":"0.0.0.0/0","NatGatewayId":"nat-01-eu4","State":"active"},{"DestinationCidrBlock":"10.24.5.99/32","NetworkInterfaceId":"eni-0a1b2c3d","State":"active"}] ,"PropagatingVgws":[],"Associations":[{"RouteTableAssociationId":"rtbassoc-0","Main":false}]}]}
```

net-bot: TGW route propagation: attachment-abc123 -> propagated routes present (40/40).

jia: DNS: delegated private zone rwd-eu4.internal -> NS set created in parent zone, glue validated. Ran `dig +short @10.0.2.10 _rwd-svc._tcp.rwd-eu4.internal SRV` returns records.

marta: Good. On security groups/NACLs — confirm ephemeral ports allowed from NAT to internet and inbound service ports from ALB -> GPU nodes.

jia: SG checks done: sg-gpu-nodes allows 1024-65535 from sg-alb and 22 from mgmt-cidr, egress 0.0.0.0/0. NACLs are stateless but mirror allow for ephemeral 1024-65535.

sam: Validation smoke: start job to pull model artifact from S3 via private link and run 1 inference to check egress path and latency counters.

jia: Running smoke-runner job (k8s job) — logs show successful S3 GET and model load. latency ~ 48ms token-step. no 5xx.

-- log snippet --
[2028-06-05T14:02:11Z] GET s3://redwood-models/g4/xl/weights.bin 200 12.4s
[2028-06-05T14:02:23Z] Model load complete
[2028-06-05T14:02:25Z] Inference OK 200 latency=48ms
-- end --

ryan: Nice. Any NAT port exhaustion warnings? CloudWatch alarm for NAT port usage should be in the stack.

jia: CloudWatch shows current port utilization 12% across AZs. set alarm threshold 70% in the template.

marta: Cost note recorded: estimate ~ $1.6k/month extra for 3 NAT gateways across AZs at expected throughput; recommend review with Finance if we keep cluster at this scale.

sam: Two remaining validation items before handoff: 1) cross-region failover route test (simulate tgw failover) 2) TTL checks for private DNS delegation.

jia: Running failover test now: route withdraw simulated, route convergence ~ 45s, fallback to regional-model-fallback works. TTLs for DNS are 30s for service SRV records.

elena: I'll take ownership for on-call for the first 48h post-launch. please add runbook link and escalation policy in the final message.

jia: final checklist posted to runbooks/infra/eu-west-4-connectivity.md and added escalation: pager -> infra-oncall -> eng-sre-senior. handing over to @elena. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Deploy job #3821 succeeded: tgws/peerings/apply (duration 2m 18s)

elena: Thanks everyone, I'll watch dashboards and report back at +12h. feel free to ping me in this thread for anything urgent. :eyes:"
